Headquarters: New York City, Remote

Alloy is where you belong!

Alloy is the AI-powered identity and fraud prevention platform that accelerates onboarding, stops fraud, and scales compliance across the customer lifecycle so financial organizations can grow without limits. More than 900 of the world's leading financial institutions and fintechs trust Alloy for smarter risk management that drives growth.

Through our values: Be Bold, Go Fast, Collaborate, and Celebrate Our Differences, we are creating a workplace where you can grow, thrive, and belong. See how we’ve been continuously recognized and named one of Inc. Magazine’s Best Workplaces, Forbes America’s Best Startup Employers, Best Fintech to Work for by American Banker, year after year.

Check out our investors and read more about us here.

About the team

We're standing up a new function at Alloy: Forward Deployed Engineering. Our largest enterprise customers need a trusted technical partner with a strong point of view on how Alloy fits into their tech stack and fraud strategy. As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you'll be that partner - embedded with our most strategic accounts and owning the technical outcome end-to-end, with each deployment becoming the foundation for the next.

You'll be one of the first two engineers on this founding team. This is a software engineering role through and through - based within our Engineering org, with a scope that spans software, product, and solutions engineering. You won't just join this function - you'll define how it works.

Alloy operates in a hybrid-work environment. We look to foster collaboration and community by having our local employees onsite three days a week.

What you'll be doing

• Architect and tune customer and channel-partner deployments end-to-end — API integrations, third-party data integrations, SDKs, and latency constraints.

• Write production code across our stack: TypeScript, JavaScript (ES6/React), Python (Django), Node.js, PostgreSQL, OpenSearch, and AWS.

• Serve as Alloy's credible technical voice with customer engineering leadership, making architectural calls in real time.

• Own the engineering track of QBRs for your accounts and serve in their on-call escalation path.

• Turn your work into reusable platform primitives and docs, so each deployment makes the next one faster.

Who we’re looking for

• 5+ years of hands-on experience developing production-ready software, with a proven track record of delivering robust, scalable solutions.

• Experience in a customer-facing technical role, Forward Deployed Engineering, solutions engineering with deep technical ownership, or similar - where you were accountable to an external stakeholder, not just an internal roadmap.

• Strong backend and API fluency, with the ability to read and write production code across services you don't own.

• Sound architectural judgment under ambiguity: you can make and defend technical decisions in the room, with a customer watching.

• A genuine pull toward customer-facing work - you find energy in solving a real customer's real problem, alongside their engineers.

• A clear technical communicator who can explain a complex integration tradeoff to a bank's VP of Engineering and to an Alloy PM in the same afternoon.

• Ability to travel on occasion to our NYC office, as well as client offices in the US.

Nice to have:

• Experience at a company with a strong Forward Deployed Engineering culture (Palantir, Scale AI, Ramp, Plaid, Stripe, etc.).

• Familiarity with identity, fraud, KYC/KYB, or financial services infrastructure.

• Experience with SDK development or embedded front-end integrations.

We're a lean team, so your impact will be felt immediately, and opportunities will grow as the company scales up. If this all sounds like a good fit for you, why not join us?

Alloy is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. Below is the anticipated starting base compensation range for this role; however, pay may vary depending on job-related knowledge, in-demand skills, relevant experience, and/or geography. In addition to a competitive base salary, this position is also eligible for equity awards in the form of stock options (ISOs) as well as a competitive total benefits package. Your recruiter will be happy to walk you through the details and what compensation could look like for you specifically!

This position has a salary range of $141,000 to $250,000. 

Benefits and Perks 

• Unlimited PTO and flexible work policy

• Employee stock options

• Medical, dental, vision plans with HSA (monthly employer contribution) and FSA options

• 401k with 100% match up to 4% of annual employee compensation 

• Eligible new parents receive 16 weeks of paid parental leave 

• Home office stipend for new employees

• Annual Learning & Development annual stipend

• Well-being benefits include access to ClassPass, OneMedical, UrbanSitter, and Spring Health 

How to apply

Apply right here! You've found the application!

Alloy is proud to be an equal-opportunity workplace and employer. We’re committed to equal opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, gender, gender identity, parental or pregnancy status, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, or veteran status. We are committed to an inclusive interview experience and provide reasonable accommodations to applicants with visible and invisible disabilities. We encourage applicants to share needed accommodations with their recruiter.

All Alloy jobs are listed on our careers page. Any communication during the recruitment process, including interview requests or job offers, will come directly from a recruiting team member with an alloy.com email address. We do not use outside applications or automated text messaging in our recruiting process. We will not ask for any sensitive financial or identification information during the recruiting process. If you’re ever unsure, please contact us directly via our website before sharing personal information.

Company Overview 

Capwise Financial Services is a full-service investment banking and financial advisory firm that helps businesses raise capital, execute strategic transactions, and navigate complex financial decisions across domestic and cross-border markets. With experience spanning 200+ debt transactions and 35+ equity and M&A deals, the firm combines a strong origination network with an active deal pipeline and a partner-led model, where sector heads own their client franchise, revenue budgets, and teams, supported by Capwise’s broader platform, central origination network, and execution capabilities.

Position Overview

We are looking for an experienced Investment Banking professional to lead deal execution for our Industrial vertical, while building an increasing origination footprint. This role owns transactions from structuring through closure and works closely with senior leadership to convert relationships into mandates.

Key Responsibilities

1 Origination & Client Relationship Management
•    Origination Contribution: Actively originate and convert prospects into mandates within the Industrial vertical, working alongside senior leadership and the firm's origination network.
•    Mandate Structuring: Draft, negotiate, and finalize Mandate Letters, Engagement Agreements, and fee structures, protecting the firm's commercial interests.
•    Client Relationships: Serve as a senior point of contact for promoters, founders, and boards, advising on capital structuring, valuation, and transaction timing.
•    Cross-Selling: Identify opportunities to cross-sell equity advisory, structured debt, and capital markets services within existing client relationships.

2. Transaction Execution & Deal Leadership
•    Deal Leadership: Lead end-to-end execution of M&A and fundraising mandates — structuring, valuation, negotiations, due diligence, and documentation.
•    Data Room & Due Diligence: Set up and manage Virtual Data Rooms, and coordinate financial, legal, tax, and commercial due diligence to resolve bottlenecks.
•    Collateral Oversight: Supervise the quality of financial models, valuation analyses, pitch books, CIMs, and management presentations produced by the deal team.
•    Definitive Documentation: Work with legal counsel to negotiate and finalize SPAs, SSAs, SHAs, and other definitive agreements.

3. Market Intelligence & Investor Networks
•    Market Tracking: Track market trends and Industrial sector developments relevant to live and prospective mandates.
•    Investor Relationships: Build and maintain relationships with PE funds, strategic investors, family offices, and VCs in support of live transactions.

4. Team Leadership & People Development
•    Mentorship: Mentor and manage Associates and Managers within deal teams, reviewing their work and supporting their development.
•    Team Culture: Contribute to a performance-oriented culture within the vertical.

5. Financial Oversight & Governance
•    Quality Review: Review financial models, valuations, and deal economics prepared by the team for accuracy and market alignment.
•    Compliance: Ensure transactions comply with regulatory, governance, and ethical standards.

Qualifications & Experience

Education: MBA from a Tier-1 business school, Chartered Accountant (CA), or CFA.
Experience: 10 to 12+ years of core investment banking experience within a reputed IB firm, institutional platform, or boutique advisory house, including substantial coverage of industrial and manufacturing clients.
Track Record: A proven history of successfully closing mid-to-large cap M&A and fundraising transactions. Must be able to demonstrate an extensive list of closed deals, together with evidence of personally originated revenue and, ideally, prior ownership of a revenue budget or practice P&L.
Sector Expertise: Deep domain knowledge of industrial value chains (manufacturing, capital goods, auto ancillaries, chemicals, metals, infrastructure), familiarity with the relevant regulatory and environmental regime, and active networks among strategic acquirers, PE/infrastructure funds, and promoter groups in the sector.

Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.

The Community You Will Join:

Investigations and Resolutions (I&R) and Law Enforcement (LE) Ops is at the heart of keeping Airbnb safe for the millions of hosts and guests who trust our platform every day. As part of Global Operations, the team reviews and resolves potential fraud and safety cases across the full user lifecycle, with internal and partner specialists operating 24/7 across the globe.

You'll join Frontline Operations, the pillar that does that review and resolution work. Our specialists and the partner teams who deliver alongside us handle cases around the clock, and the leads, managers and analysts across the pillar make sure that work is fast, accurate and consistent wherever it runs.

You'll lead a team on I&R and LE Ops within Frontline Operations, working day to day with Policy, Product and the Legal teams that carry cases alongside your team.

The Difference You Will Make:

You lead a team of I&R and LE Ops specialists: you decide how their work is prioritised as volume, risk and resourcing move through the week, and you coach the judgement that makes their decisions consistent whoever handles the case.

The difference you make is a team that performs to a high standard all the time — not only when volume is manageable. That reliability is what the rest of FSD plans around.

Success looks like a team that consistently meets its quality, service-level and resolution-time targets, fewer repeat escalations because a change is applied the same way by everyone, and specialists who stay and grow because the path in front of them is clear.

A Typical Day:

  • Lead and develop a team of I&R and LE Ops specialists, holding the team accountable for quality, timeliness, and service goals while championing their growth and overall team engagement.
  • Adapt the team's plan and make the day-to-day decisions on case handling, escalation and coverage as volume, case mix or resourcing shifts. For example: rebalancing the queue and re-cutting coverage when a surge in account-takeover reports lands on a public holiday with half the team off.
  • Coach and develop your specialists through regular 1:1s and case reviews, manage performance against targets, and model the values and belonging behaviours that make the team people stay.
  • Use judgment and the operational data to resolve the technical, customer and operational problems your team raises, and recommend the process and tooling improvements the pattern points to.
  • Take process, tooling and workflow changes as an input from the broader fraud and safety strategy and land them with your team, and hand off the cases that need executive escalation or new precedent to the appropriate senior stakeholder.
  • Watch your team's operational metrics, report the trends and risks in your remit to leadership, and anticipate resourcing needs so you can raise a gap to your manager before it becomes a blocker.

Your Expertise:

  • 10+ years in Fraud & Safety, Risk, Trust or related operations, including 4+ years leading or supervising a team in a high-volume, time-sensitive case-review environment.
  • Proven ability to hold a team of specialists to consistent quality, accuracy and productivity targets, using operational data to see where performance is moving and act on it.
  • Working knowledge of fraud and safety typologies, and how workflow, precedent and policy interact on escalated cases.
  • People leadership at the scope named above — led a team of specialists whose decisions carried real consequence, coaching a diverse group of talent and setting team priorities and performance targets.
  • Sound operational judgment when the answer is not clear — you assess the situation, decide with the information you have, and adapt the plan rather than waiting for direction.
  • Clear, direct communicator — able to make operational and case reasoning legible to your specialists, to your cross-functional partners, and to the leadership tracking your team's results.
  • Experience in a marketplace, travel or platform fraud and safety environment, or building SOPs, playbooks and enablement that scaled beyond one team, is a plus, not a requirement.

Our Commitment To Inclusion & Belonging:

Airbnb is committed to working with the broadest talent pool possible. We believe diverse ideas foster innovation and engagement, and allow us to attract creatively-led people, and to develop the best products, services and solutions. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply.

Staff Frontend Engineer

An overview of this role

As a Staff Frontend Engineer on the Core DevOps team, you'll provide technical leadership across your team and adjacent teams. You'll solve complex frontend problems, deliver large features with minimal guidance, and improve the architecture and standards that help teams move faster without compromising quality.

You'll work with product, design, engineering managers, and engineers across product groups to shape product experiences and frontend architecture for a global platform. This includes how teams use agentic artificial intelligence in engineering workflows and user experiences.

On the Core DevOps team, we own core repository capabilities, from Git command-line operations to web-based code exploration. We develop new features and platforms, improve existing capabilities, and improve maintainability, accessibility, performance, and workflows for teams using artificial-intelligence-assisted development tools.

Headquarters: Vancouver
 
URL: https://www.roveconcepts.com/

Company: Rove Next, by Rove Concepts
Location: Remote. Open across the Americas and Europe.
Hours: Full-time overlap with Pacific or Eastern time. This is a requirement, not a preference.
Type: Independent contractor, full time

About the role

Rove Next is a new premium line from Rove Concepts, a Vancouver-based modern furniture brand selling direct to consumer across Canada and the US. Rove Next launches with improved versions of our best-selling pieces, and it needs its own marketing built from the ground up.

That's this role. You'll own how Rove Next reaches customers and keeps them, starting with email and lifecycle. The goal is a marketing function that scales through AI and systems rather than through headcount, and the advantage here is that you're building it clean rather than inheriting one.

This is not a coordination role. We need someone who takes a problem and builds the answer, and who catches things before they reach leadership.

Scope

Initially focused on Rove Next, with room to expand across the Rove Concepts group as the brand grows.

What you'll own

Email and lifecycle as our primary owned channel. Campaign calendar, flows, segmentation, deliverability, list health. We run on Klaviyo.

Quality control on everything that ships. Copy, creative, link destinations, offers, regional versions. If something goes out wrong, it was yours to catch.

Building AI into the daily work. Not proposing it, shipping it.

Working alongside our lifecycle and email team, our designers, and our external ads partner to keep the calendar moving.

Translating results into plain business language. What we spent, what we made, what we'd do differently.

Must-haves

Five or more years in ecommerce or DTC marketing with real ownership of email and lifecycle. Klaviyo or a comparable ESP.

Evidence that you build with AI yourself rather than assigning it. When you hit a wall, your instinct should be to build through it, not to raise a ticket and wait.

Fluent, native-level English, written and spoken. This one is non-negotiable. You will be writing copy that goes out to our customers under our name, so we need someone who can hear the difference between a line that sounds premium and one that sounds like a discount retailer.

A strong eye. You can look at an asset and tell whether the destination matches the promise, whether the tone is right, and whether the offer math actually adds up.

Comfortable being told when something isn't landing, and comfortable telling us the same.

Nice to have

Furniture, home, or another considered-purchase category with a long buying cycle. Shopify, GA4 and Meta Ads familiarity. Experience holding a team to brand guidelines.

What success looks like

Flow revenue grows as a share of total email revenue. Work stops reaching leadership with errors in it. AI is doing measurable work inside the function within 90 days, rather than sitting in a proposal.

Compensation

$3,500 to $4,500 USD per month depending on experience. Independent contractor.

How to apply

Send your CV and in a few lines, tell us two things:

One AI workflow or automation you built yourself in a real business. What it did, and what it saved.

One time you caught something before it shipped that nobody else had noticed.

Please also include a short voice note, around 60 seconds, introducing yourself and telling us what you'd want to know before writing your first email for us.

Shortlisted candidates will be asked to complete a short paid project.

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/rove-concepts-marketing-manager-ai-and-lifecycle

The next phase requires engineers who can build reliable systems, move quickly, and take ownership beyond just completing assigned tasks. ## THE ROLE As a Senior Software Engineer at Clara AI, you will be a hands-on engineer responsible for building and scaling AI-native products from concept to production. You will work closely with product, engineering, and customers to understand problems, design solutions, and ship production-quality software. This is not a role where you simply execute predefined technical tasks. We are looking for engineers who can identify problems, make sound technical decisions, and own solutions end-to-end. ## WHAT YOU'LL OWN ### Build AI-native products You will work on products where AI is a core capability. You may work across: * AI agents and autonomous workflows * LLM-powered applications * Intelligent automation systems * Knowledge retrieval and reasoning systems * AI evaluation and improvement frameworks ### Own technical problems end-to-end You will: * Design and build production systems * Make technical decisions and evaluate tradeoffs * Build scalable APIs and backend systems * Work across the stack where required * Debug complex technical problems * Improve system reliability, performance, and maintainability * Take ownership of features from idea to production ### Work closely with product and customers You will work closely with product and business teams to understand real customer problems and translate them into technical solutions. You will be expected to think beyond the implementation and understand the business impact of what you build. ### Stay hands-on This is a highly hands-on engineering role. You will: * Write production-quality code * Prototype and test new ideas * Participate in architecture and system design discussions * Review code and improve engineering practices * Use AI tools extensively to improve engineering velocity * Continuously learn and adapt to new technologies ## WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE ### First 30 Days * Build strong context around Clara AI's technology and customers * Understand existing systems and engineering practices * Start shipping meaningful improvements * Identify opportunities to improve product or engineering velocity ### First 60 Days * Own significant technical initiatives * Deliver production features independently * Improve system quality, reliability, or performance * Contribute meaningfully to architecture and technical decisions ### First 90 Days * Independently own important areas of the product * Ship meaningful AI-native capabilities * Raise engineering quality and technical standards * Become a reliable technical owner within the team ## WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR ### Must Have * **3–7 years of software engineering experience** * Strong hands-on engineering background * Experience building and scaling production systems * Strong problem-solving and engineering fundamentals * Experience owning features or technical initiatives end-to-end * Strong understanding of backend systems and APIs * Product mindset and ability to understand customer problems * Comfortable working in ambiguity and fast-changing environments ### Strong Signals * Has been an early engineer or worked in a startup environment * Has built products or features from zero to one * Experience with AI-powered products or LLM applications * Uses AI tools extensively to improve engineering velocity * Strong full-stack experience * Has worked closely with product or customers * Demonstrates strong ownership beyond their defined role * Has a track record of learning new technologies quickly ## TECHNICAL EXPECTATIONS Experience with some of the following: * MERN stack: React, Node.js, TypeScript * Backend architecture and APIs * Databases and distributed systems * Cloud infrastructure * AI/LLM applications * Agentic workflows * System design and scalability We value strong engineering judgment and the ability to learn quickly over specific technology keywords. ## THIS IS NOT FOR YOU IF * You prefer only executing predefined technical tasks * You need a highly structured or mature engineering environment * You avoid product or customer discussions * You are not excited about building with AI * You are uncomfortable taking ownership beyond your immediate task * You prefer optimizing for technical complexity over solving real customer problems ## WHAT WE OFFER ### High Ownership Own meaningful technical problems and see your work directly impact the product. ### Build with AI Work on products where AI is fundamentally changing how businesses operate. ### Direct Impact Your work will power products used by real businesses every day. ### High Autonomy Identify problems, propose solutions, make technical decisions, and build. **Bangalore · Full-time · AI-native environment**
